headlines.title: 广发证券：地产板块估值“底背离” 核心优质房企具备长期配置价值
headlines.summary: 广发证券研报表示，地产板块估值“底背离”，核心优质房企具备长期配置价值。2026年上半年，SW地产板块累计跌16.4%，跑输大盘（沪深300）24个百分点，16家主流房企跌14.9%。当前股价中包含房价下跌预期为16%，而过去半年房价已经止跌，偏离程度达到2021年以来的最大值。短期看好板块偏离修复的反弹机会，9、10月份后若核心城市成交中枢进一步抬升，房价加速上涨，则板块具备价值反转的机会。个股选择上，短期销售增长对股价的影响依然有效，同时要兼顾企业的投资拓展表现以及估值情况。

headlines.title_en: GF Securities: Real estate sector valuation shows 'bottom divergence'; core quality developers offer long-term allocation value
headlines.summary_en: GF Securities research note: property sector valuation shows 'bottom divergence'; core quality developers have long-term allocation value. In H1 2026, SW property sector fell 16.4%, underperforming the CSI 300 by 24 percentage points; 16 major developers fell 14.9%. Current stock prices imply a 16% home price decline expectation, though prices have stabilized over the past six months; deviation is the largest since 2021. Short-term, see rebound opportunities from valuation correction; after September-October, if core city sales volumes rise further and prices accelerate, the sector may see value reversal. Stock picks: short-term sales growth still impacts prices, while considering investment expansion and valuations.

headlines.title: China’s debt ratio dips as households cut borrowing and firms slash investment: report
headlines.summary:
China’s debt-to-GDP ratio fell in the second quarter for the first time since 2022, even as the government kept borrowing while households and private companies pulled back under the weight of falling home prices, sluggish income growth and shrinking profit margins, according to a new report.
The ratio slipped 1.1 percentage points to 308.2 per cent, the National Institution for Finance and Development (NIFD), a Beijing-based think tank, said in a quarterly report on Thursday.

headlines.title_zh: 中国债务比率回落，家庭减少借贷、企业削减投资：报告
headlines.summary_zh: 最新报告显示，尽管政府持续借贷，但家庭和企业因房价下跌、收入增长乏力及利润空间收窄而减少借贷，中国第二季度债务与国内生产总值之比自2022年以来首次下降。该比率下降1.1个百分点，至308.2%。

headlines.title: 中国财政部多个期限点心债发行利率创新低 认购倍数逾一年新高
headlines.summary: 中国财政部周三公告，在香港发行了规模150亿元人民币主权债，其中2年期、15年期和30年期品种发行利率均创新低。3年期和5年期发行利率刷新2011年以来最低水平。5只人民币主权债的整体认购倍数4.67倍，为2025年6月来最高。发行2年期50亿元，发行利率1.27%；3年期40亿元，发行利率1.30%；5年期40亿元，发行利率1.43%；15年期10亿元，发行利率1.99%；30年期10亿元，发行利率2.24%。

headlines.title_en: China's Ministry of Finance sees record-low issuance rates for multiple tenors of dim sum bonds; subscription multiples hit over one-year high
headlines.summary_en: China's Ministry of Finance announced Wednesday issuing CNY 15 billion sovereign bonds in Hong Kong, with record-low yields on 2-year, 15-year, and 30-year tranches. 3-year and 5-year yields hit lows since 2011. Overall subscription ratio for the five RMB sovereign bonds was 4.67x, highest since June 2025. Issued CNY 5 billion of 2-year bonds at 1.27%; CNY 4 billion of 3-year at 1.30%; CNY 4 billion of 5-year at 1.43%; CNY 1 billion of 15-year at 1.99%; CNY 1 billion of 30-year at 2.24%.

headlines.title: 深圳楼市7月淡季不淡 二手豪宅签约量达近六年峰值
headlines.summary: 据深圳市房地产信息平台数据，7月，深圳全市新建商品房共计成交4502套，环比下跌约35%，同比上涨19.3%；其中住宅成交3529套，环比下跌7%，同比上涨约33%。二手房方面的表现同样韧性十足。据第三方机构乐有家研究中心统计，7月，二手住宅网签4795套，环比下跌6%，同比上涨3%，持续稳定在5000套“荣枯线”水平附近。在高端改善的豪宅方面，7月的市场表现同样坚挺。据深圳贝壳研究院监测，总价1500万以上二手豪宅签约量同比增长11%，达到近六年峰值，高端置业需求持续积极释放。

headlines.title_en: Shenzhen property market resilient in July off-season; second-hand luxury home transactions hit six-year peak
headlines.summary_en: Per Shenzhen Real Estate Information Platform data, July new commercial housing sales in Shenzhen totaled 4,502 units, down about 35% MoM and up 19.3% YoY; residential sales were 3,529 units, down 7% MoM and up about 33% YoY. Resale market also resilient: per Leyoujia Research Center, July second-hand residential signings were 4,795 units, down 6% MoM and up 3% YoY, holding near the 5,000-unit 'boom-bust line'. For luxury homes, July remained firm: per Shenzhen Beike Research Institute, second-hand luxury home signings above CNY 15 million rose 11% YoY, a six-year peak, with high-end demand actively releasing.

headlines.summary_en: 1. Markets opened lower then rallied; STAR 50 up over 5%. Semiconductor chips rallied; Zhongjuxin, Zhengfan Technology, Jinhaitong, Dawei Co., etc. hit daily limits. Precious metals sector rose; Sichuan Gold hit limit-up. PCB concept stocks gained; Zhongjing Electronics, Huazheng New Materials, etc. hit limits. Intelligent driving concept active; Suoling Shares, Zhejiang Shibao, Xingmin Zhitong, etc. hit limits. More stocks rose than fell; over 3,900 stocks in Shanghai, Shenzhen, Beijing were up; morning turnover hit CNY 1.7 trillion. At midday close, Shanghai Composite up 1.34%, Shenzhen Component up 1.56%, ChiNext up 0.89%. 2. Sector-wise, semiconductor chips, precious metals, computing hardware, consumer electronics led gains; oil & gas, banks, baijiu, Chinese medicine fell against the trend. 3. A-shares: 3,631 stocks rose, 89 hit limit-up; 1,351 fell, 2 hit limit-down.

headlines.title: A股“易中天”集体回应美国光模块禁令
headlines.summary: A股通信设备板块今日开盘下跌，随后跌幅集体收窄。有市场消息称，美国联邦通信委员会（FCC）正在起草一项禁令，旨在禁止美国进口中国数据中心组件新机型，包括光模块。当日，记者以投资者身份分别致电中际旭创、新易盛、天孚通信董秘办。中际旭创董秘办工作人员称，公司已注意到相关市场信息，经核实，美国联邦通信委员会尚未出台相关领域限制性文件。该负责人称，“因为美国联邦通信委员会并未出台相关领域限制性文件，公司对相关传闻不予评述。”

headlines.title_en: A-Share 'Yizhongtian' Collectively Responds to US Optical Module Ban
headlines.summary_en: A-share communications equipment sector opened lower today, with losses narrowing across the board later. Market sources said the U.S. Federal Communications Commission (FCC) is drafting a ban aimed at prohibiting U.S. imports of new models of Chinese data center components, including optical modules. On the day, a reporter called the board secretary offices of Zhongji Innolight, Eoptolink, and T&S Communications as investors. A staff member at Zhongji Innolight's board secretary office said the company had noted the relevant market information and, after verification, the FCC has not yet issued restrictive documents in the relevant field. The official said, "Because the FCC has not issued restrictive documents in the relevant field, the company will not comment on related rumors."
